tickets.title: Coordinate Missing Signature Follow-Up
tickets.text: Use this coordination workflow when paperwork cannot be submitted or processed because a signature, initials, date, or required authorization is missing. Confirm the needed correction before contacting the client and keep the request limited to the deficient item. The Velvet Acorn Custody bank authorization package for Selena Thimblefern's 529 distributions shows her printed name and Teacup Comet Bank information but lacks the required authorization signature page.

subTasks.title: Validate the missing signature requirement
subTasks.text: Review the form package and processing notes to identify the exact missing signature, initials, date, or authorization. Confirm whether wet signature, e-signature, or custodian-specific language is required.

subTasks.title: Confirm planning or account impact
subTasks.text: Determine whether the missing signature affects account opening, transfer timing, trading authority, beneficiary changes, or other planning deadlines. Note any client-facing implications for the advisor.

subTasks.title: Send corrected signature request
subTasks.text: Contact the client through the approved secure channel with clear instructions, the corrected form or signature page, and a brief explanation of what is needed. Avoid sending unnecessary pages containing sensitive information.

subTasks.title: Advisor confirmation before resubmission
subTasks.text: Review the completed correction and confirm the package is ready for resubmission or escalation if the client has questions about the request.

tickets.title: Prepare Retirement Income Plan Checklist
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before presenting the retirement income plan:

- Confirm desired retirement timing and any phased-work assumptions.
- Verify recurring spending needs, irregular expenses, and emergency reserve target.
- Review Social Security claiming assumptions and pension options, if applicable.
- Identify taxable, tax-deferred, and Roth account balances available for withdrawals.
- Estimate sustainable withdrawal range under base, cautious, and stress scenarios.
- Check required minimum distribution timing and tax bracket considerations.
- Coordinate investment allocation with near-term cash flow needs.
- Identify healthcare, Medicare, long-term care, and insurance considerations.
- Document recommended income sources for the next planning period.
- List open items, assumptions, and follow-up decisions for the client.
